h15.text: Beginning with the entering fall 2025 class, Hollins expanded the HOPE program to serve a nationwide audience. The expanded program provides financial support for direct costs including tuition, on-campus food and housing, and required fees with no loans through a combination of Hollins funds, as well as any applicable federal and state aid for selected students.
